Official Announcement: US-ASIA COMMUNITY DAY at ETH DENVER 2025
APAC DAO & @lukso_io are excited to co-host the largest US-Asia Web3 gathering at @EthereumDenver, bringing together the brightest minds in blockchain to discuss market opportunities, funding, and cross-border partnerships.
📅 Date: February 25, 2025
📍 Venue: Green Spaces, Denver
This exclusive event is powered by @Uniswap , @IvoryLabsXYZ  & @ttt_lab, uniting top Web3 builders, investors, and thought leaders from both sides of the globe.
Why Attend?
1. Expand your network—Meet leading VCs, founders & builders from APAC & US
2. Discover new market opportunities—Insights into the Web3 expansion in Asia & the US
3. Collaborate & scale—Explore funding, partnerships & strategic growth
4. Join exclusive discussions—Learn from Web3 pioneers building across regions
Agenda Highlights:
- Opening Remarks – Meet the organizers & sponsors
- US & APAC Web3 Market Overview – Understanding the opportunities in both regions
- Founder Roundtable – Navigating challenges, scaling strategies & funding
- Open Networking – Forge meaningful connections with Web3 leaders
📌 Secure your spot now! Limited capacity, register today: https://lu.ma/ulm5bpeb
We can’t wait to welcome you to ETH Denver’s premier international Web3 gathering! See you there!
